_comment: Expected sha256 of every binary bundled from aurie-loader/. Checked by scripts/verify-loader.mjs, wired into `npm run check`, and read by src-tauri (embedded at compile time via include_str!) so the installer and the check agree on one file. Update the relevant entry whenever a loader binary is intentionally replaced (see docs/submodules/HS-Offline-Tracker/instructions.md, 'Bundled Loader & Modified YYToolkit'). 'supersedes' lists the sha256 of every earlier release of that same file this bundle is known to safely replace on an existing installation; the installer updates Missing and Superseded copies and leaves anything else (an 'Unknown' hash — maybe a newer loader another tool installed) alone. A hash leaves this list only if it is never expected on a live installation again.
